messages:
sarah: kicking off this incident thread — high-rate 5xx/timeouts observed on hosted /v1/generate in us-east starting ~20:12 UTC. p95 latency climbed from 200ms -> 1.2s, p99 ~8s, and ~18% 5xx spikes. clients report streaming timeouts and opaque 502s :frowning:
mike: on it. can you drop the top logs and a repro curl? any rollout around that time?
sarah: no deploys in window. quick repro curl (sanitized):
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"model":"rwd-7b","input":"short prompt","max_tokens":512}'
```
we saw nginx upstream read timeout and 502 from gateway. stack trace snippets attached in ticket.
ravi: pulling traces. I'm seeing long queue latency on batcher: avg queue depth spikes from 3 -> 40 on some hosts, KV-cache hit-rate drops concurrently. suspect batching + keepalive churn. Also seeing many client SDK parallel retries increasing fanout.
carla: opsteam: deploy-batcher v2.3.1 rolled 2 days ago — could be new backpressure knob. ops-bot, did autoscaler kick?
ops-bot: autoscaler: scaled +3 serving pods at 2026-03-18T20:14Z. scale reason: queue_latency > 500ms. No failed deploys.
mike: mitigation proposal: temporarily disable dynamic batching on the endpoint and set batch_max_wait to 5ms, to trade some throughput for latency stability. will toggle via console now.
sarah: doing the toggle. disabling dynamic batching for /v1/generate (us-east) for 10m window.
carla: noticed immediate drop in 5xx from ~18% -> 1.7% within 60s of disable. p95 now ~220ms. good signal that batching backpressure is implicated.
ravi: notes for repro/playback: reproduce load pattern with many small parallel requests (clients using SDK default concurrency=8). local replay shows same queue buildup when batch_max_wait > 50ms.
mike: action items (short):
- mike: open PR to add backpressure circuit + dynamic batch backoff (change batch_max_wait heuristic)
- carla: update runbook to include endpoint toggle and safe rollback steps
- sarah: add alert: queue_latency > 400ms AND 5xx_rate > 3% -> paging policy
- ravi: run canary test harness with mixed small-parallel requests and verify default SDK retry/jitter behavior
I'll draft PR today and ping for review.
sarah: I'll file the postmortem skeleton and include timeline + customer-impact notes in INC-9123. we should also check billing spikes for impacted customers and reach out if needed.
carla: +1. I'll also schedule a cross-team sync with devex to discuss SDK retry defaults.
mike: quick one — add a short-term mitigation permanently? maybe lower default batch_max_wait for hosted endpoints until we ship smarter backpressure.
ravi: agreed. I'll add that to the PM checklist. closing incident thread for now; monitoring for 2h. will update INC-9123 with final RCA and owners.
sarah: thanks all. :thumbsup:
